$comment: AUTO-GENERATED by tools/optimize-images.sh. Do not edit by hand. This is the image contract for every page task: 'w' and 'h' are the REAL intrinsic pixels of the file named in 'webp' and MUST be copied verbatim into the width/height attributes of the so CLS stays at 0. All paths are repo-root-relative; pages under blog/ or wy/ must prefix '../'. Never emit a root-absolute path - the site is served from /minthep-portfolio/.

usage.lqip: Where lqipVar is non-null: link css/lqip.css, then background-image: var(--lqip-<slot>); background-size: cover; on the wrapper, and background-color: var(--tint-<slot>) as the flat fallback. Clear it in JS on the img 'load' event.
usage.note: avif is null when AVIF was not at least 10% smaller than the WebP sibling; see avifStatus.
usage.caseBug: blog/textblog-3/Histogram.webp and blog/textblog-5/Scrum-model.webp were 404ing on GitHub Pages because the HTML referenced them lowercase. Both spellings now exist (added, never renamed). Prefer the exact-cased original.
